actual: On clean main 1182e925, the first authorized P2-4 request preparation failed after holdout access but before product acceptance. The direct root cause is not an unaudited normal provider absence: market.suspend_d records 601969.SH/2026-01-30 as suspend_type=S, while market.kline_daily_raw contains a synthetic zero-volume/zero-amount flat bar. Both stock-fact observed-price readers ignore suspend_d, hard-code is_suspended=false, and evaluate moneyflow, so a normal full-day suspension becomes provider_absence_unverified and terminates the whole P2-4 source load. Both missing-price readers also exclude every suspend_d row without distinguishing full-day S from R-only or true intraday suspension. Formal holdout readback proves five dates have same-day blank-timing S/R and no price before a later real traded resume, while two dates use the provider full-day sentinel 09:30-09:30; same-day R therefore cannot by itself override full-day suspension. Price lag windows are built before suspension filtering, so synthetic suspension bars can also enter previous-close lags. The P2-4 CLI then collapses the typed source failure to hmm_risk_p2_4_unknown_execution_failure. Durable receipt canonical e4397982 remains immutable with holdout_accessed=true, product_acceptance_performed=false, and zero fit/selection/model/READY/DB/runtime.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Restore authoritative full-day suspension handling before price lag and moneyflow evaluation in every HMM stock-fact reader. A full-day S row with blank suspend_timing or the provider full-day sentinel 09:30-09:30 must be excluded from price history, contributor evaluation, missing-price evidence and provider-absence validation even when a same-day R record also exists. R-only rows and all other intraday suspension timings remain ordinary trading candidates; missing prices on those rows remain explicit missing_non_suspended evidence rather than being silently excluded. Zero-volume rows without authoritative full-day suspension evidence must not be guessed as suspended. P2-4 source loader failures must persist a typed source reason instead of unknown_execution_failure. Preserve the frozen candidate, D1-D6, zero refit/reselection, original failure receipt and zero DB/runtime side effects. A post-fix formal holdout rerun remains separately user-controlled.
expected: Normal full-day suspensions, including same-day S/R and 09:30-09:30 sentinel cases without actual trading, are authoritatively excluded without evaluating moneyflow or failing the whole HMM source load; R-only and true intraday rows are not misclassified as full-day suspension; previous-close lags exclude synthetic full-day suspension bars; genuine non-suspension source defects remain fail-closed with a typed P2-4 source reason.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
title: P2-4 stock-fact reader misclassifies full-day suspension and hides resume-date gaps
